name: Claudia Sheinbaum
role: President of Mexico (2024-present); head of government of Mexico City (2018-2023)
summary: Sheinbaum is a Morena politician and energy scientist who governs on an expansive state-led welfare and public-enterprise programme (Pemex and CFE as public companies, constitutionalised social programmes, rising minimum wage) alongside fiscal discipline, central-bank autonomy and openness to private investment. She backs popular election of judges, recall votes and a ban on re-election and nepotism, supports equal marriage and abortion rights and gender parity, and defends sovereignty and non-intervention while cooperating with the United States on security and trade.

notes: Living person: only record-based answers; nothing was inferred from party or label. Her energy stance has moved from a ban on fracking toward openness to new techniques (2026), and from "hugs not bullets" toward a harder line on organised crime; the recent position was used. Abortion and equal-marriage answers rest on her own earlier statements and tweets quoted in press; she says little on them as president. The Wikipedia pages are used for her record of enacted measures. gob.mx stenographic versions were blocked from this environment, so morning-conference quotes come via press reports. Later pass (2026-11-17): brought to rules 7, tagged sources as actions or words, dropped Wikipedia as a source (eight answers resting only on it were nulled), re-opened the cited speeches and news reports into the local library, and answered the candidate statements. Searched for her stated positions on the working week (40-hour reform, phased to 2030), climate causation, apologies for past wrongs, and the speeches for democracy promotion, torture, indigenous nations and taxes; only the apology position was found stated, so the rest are null. gob.mx transcripts of morning conferences remain unread.
